project.name: Fullview Signature — by Veridanth
project.objective: Rebrand the research platform and deliver a cohesive logo, social preview, favicon and installable PWA.
project.audience: Students, researchers, organisations and institutions in Ghana and beyond.
project.governing_idea: A fuller perspective, expressed through an FV monogram and aligned architectural frames.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Warm gold perspective geometry on deep emerald, with an exact vector monogram and generous typographic hierarchy.
anti_goals: Decorative PWA controls without offline behaviour

palette.contrast: Ivory and gold on deep emerald; emerald on warm ivory.

creative_system.composition: Strong typographic left field; perspective frames in the right field.
creative_system.typography: DM Sans and Libre Caslon Display; outlined vector masters.
creative_system.interface: Keep existing research pathways and readable mobile navigation.
invariants: Existing research services and records preserved
creative_system.camera: Static, typography-led framing with a photographic perspective field on the right.
creative_system.lighting: Warm edge light across brass frames and emerald glass against a deep green field.
